title: 强化学习训练可与环境合理交互的数字人
idea: 如何在强化学习框架下训练一个数字人（虚拟人/具身智能体），使其能够与所处环境进行合理、自然且有目的的交互——涵盖物理仿真下的全身运动控制、感知-决策-动作闭环、与场景/物体/人的交互行为，以及行为的真实性与合理性。
queries: reinforcement learning physics-based character animation humanoid control
reinforcement learning virtual human environment interaction
embodied agent reinforcement learning human-like behavior simulation
deep reinforcement learning motion control digital human avatar
imitation learning physics-based character controllers locomotion
reinforcement learning humanoid whole-body control object interaction
embodied conversational agent reinforcement learning virtual human
